payload.description: Evaluated ChatConversation patch for redundancy with existing ChatSession/ChatMessage hybrid model

existing_implementation.superiority: Existing model has all features of ChatConversation PLUS agent/persona/mode tracking

rationale: ChatSession already provides conversation continuity with unique slug
ChatMessage already has archival support (archivedAt timestamp > archived boolean)
Existing model adds agent/persona/mode metadata not in patch
Adding ChatConversation would create confusion and duplication
payload.recommendation: Use ChatSession where patch intended ChatConversation
payload.action_taken: none - patch superseded by existing implementation
